title: Getting started
description: Install the package and run your first query.
content: Install with your package manager, set the API key, and call the client. The first request warms the cache.

title: Configuration
description: Environment variables, config files and precedence.
content: Settings come from flags, then environment variables, then the config file. Secrets are never written to disk.

title: Pricing
description: What it costs and how to keep the bill small.
content: Usage is billed per request. Set a monthly budget in the dashboard to cap spend.
